About this item

  • Engineered with premium craftsmanship, this portable speaker features a space-saving form measuring a mere 2.99 inches (7.6 cm) in width and length, and 4.25 inches (10.8 cm) in height. Ultra-lightweight at just 0.688 lbs (312g), it slips effortlessly into any bag. Driven by a robust 20W peak power, it delivers immersive audio with punchy bass and crisp highs, while its 15W continuous output ensures crystal-clear sound for indoor relaxation or outdoor adventures
  • 【Beach Day Essential – IPX5 Waterproof & Sand-Resistant】 From splashing in the waves to lounging by the pool, this speaker is built for summer adventures. With IPX5 waterproof protection, it handles ocean mist, sudden rain showers, and poolside splashes without skipping a beat. When the sand settles, just rinse it off and it's ready for the next beach day. Also perfect for shower sing-alongs, backyard sprinklers, or any splashy fun
  • 【Portable Companion – From Beach Tote to Garage Bench】 Ultra-lightweight at just 0.58 lbs, it slips easily into your beach bag, gym backpack, or work toolbox. Take it from the shoreline to the garage workshop, from the office desk to the camping tent. The built-in lanyard lets you hang it on a beach umbrella, bike, or shower caddy—so your music stays close, wherever you are
  • 【Dynamic Light Show – Sets the Vibe Day or Night】 As the sun sets on the beach, let the beat-syncing LED lights turn your bonfire gathering into a glowing party. By day, it’s a fun accent for poolside lounging; by night, it transforms your bedroom, dorm, or backyard BBQ into a mini celebration. The lights dance to your music, adding energy to every moment—whether you're hosting or just chilling
  • 【Crystal-Clear Sound & 15H Battery – From Sunrise to Late Night】 Powerful 15W (20W peak) audio with zero distortion fills the space—whether you're on a crowded beach, in the living room, or cooking in the kitchen. With up to 15 hours of playtime, it keeps the soundtrack going from early morning yoga on the sand to late-night gaming or movie marathons at home
  • 【The Perfect Summer Gift – Bluetooth 5.3 & TWS Pairing】 Looking for a gift that wows? This speaker is a hit for teens heading to the beach, college kids moving into dorms, friends who love pool parties, or anyone who enjoys music at home or on the go. With Bluetooth 5.3 for instant, stable connection up to 100 ft, and TWS pairing to link two speakers for 30W stereo sound, it’s the gift that keeps the good vibes rolling—wherever summer takes them

    5 out of 5 stars
    Yes, it gives room filling VOLUME!
    For those of you who might have the same question as I had before purchasing this: How is the max volume? Is it loud enough? YES! YES! It will easily fill a 10 FT by 10 FT room. And sound is clear and bass is good for its size! Back in 2008-2009, I used the Soundmatters foxL that was like $250. Since then, these little portable speakers evolved, price went down, but performance went up. I don’t have much need for portable speaker these days so last one I used was JBL Flip5. And JBL really shines on Bass. I can tell you that perhaps clarity of this PulseSound is on par or even better than JBL. However, the Bass is below JBL Flip5. But here is the catch, this PulseSound costs way less than JBL. I am very satisfied with this product and highly recommend it.

      For those of you who might have the same question as I had before purchasing this: How is the max volume? Is it loud enough? YES! YES! It will easily fill a 10 FT by 10 FT room. And sound is clear and bass is good for its size! Back in 2008-2009, I used the Soundmatters foxL that was like $250. Since then, these little portable speakers evolved, price went down, but performance went up. I don’t have much need for portable speaker these days so last one I used was JBL Flip5. And JBL really shines on Bass. I can tell you that perhaps clarity of this PulseSound is on par or even better than JBL. However, the Bass is below JBL Flip5. But here is the catch, this PulseSound costs way less than JBL. I am very satisfied with this product and highly recommend it.

    About this Item

    • Engineered with premium craftsmanship, this portable speaker features a space-saving form measuring a mere 2.99 inches (7.6 cm) in width and length, and 4.25 inches (10.8 cm) in height. Ultra-lightweight at just 0.688 lbs (312g), it slips effortlessly into any bag. Driven by a robust 20W peak power, it delivers immersive audio with punchy bass and crisp highs, while its 15W continuous output ensures crystal-clear sound for indoor relaxation or outdoor adventures
    • 【Beach Day Essential – IPX5 Waterproof & Sand-Resistant】 From splashing in the waves to lounging by the pool, this speaker is built for summer adventures. With IPX5 waterproof protection, it handles ocean mist, sudden rain showers, and poolside splashes without skipping a beat. When the sand settles, just rinse it off and it's ready for the next beach day. Also perfect for shower sing-alongs, backyard sprinklers, or any splashy fun
    • 【Portable Companion – From Beach Tote to Garage Bench】 Ultra-lightweight at just 0.58 lbs, it slips easily into your beach bag, gym backpack, or work toolbox. Take it from the shoreline to the garage workshop, from the office desk to the camping tent. The built-in lanyard lets you hang it on a beach umbrella, bike, or shower caddy—so your music stays close, wherever you are
    • 【Dynamic Light Show – Sets the Vibe Day or Night】 As the sun sets on the beach, let the beat-syncing LED lights turn your bonfire gathering into a glowing party. By day, it’s a fun accent for poolside lounging; by night, it transforms your bedroom, dorm, or backyard BBQ into a mini celebration. The lights dance to your music, adding energy to every moment—whether you're hosting or just chilling
    • 【Crystal-Clear Sound & 15H Battery – From Sunrise to Late Night】 Powerful 15W (20W peak) audio with zero distortion fills the space—whether you're on a crowded beach, in the living room, or cooking in the kitchen. With up to 15 hours of playtime, it keeps the soundtrack going from early morning yoga on the sand to late-night gaming or movie marathons at home
    • 【The Perfect Summer Gift – Bluetooth 5.3 & TWS Pairing】 Looking for a gift that wows? This speaker is a hit for teens heading to the beach, college kids moving into dorms, friends who love pool parties, or anyone who enjoys music at home or on the go. With Bluetooth 5.3 for instant, stable connection up to 100 ft, and TWS pairing to link two speakers for 30W stereo sound, it’s the gift that keeps the good vibes rolling—wherever summer takes them

    Product Description

    With a room-filling audio experience, this compact speaker delivers impressive clarity and depth. Whether you're unwinding with soothing melodies or getting pumped up with energetic beats, the PulseSound fills your space with immersive sound, making every listening session a captivating journey. Experience a mesmerizing visual experience with the beat-synced light show feature. As you groove to your favorite tunes, the lights pulsate and dance in sync with the rhythm, enhancing your listening experience with an immersive and dynamic display. Whether you're hosting a party or simply enjoying music alone, the synchronized lights add an extra dimension of excitement and energy to your surroundings.
